text:
vera: quick follow-up from the postmortem  last night's cross-region cert flip caused an ~8m retry burst in ap-east and several SNI-mismatch TLS errors.

chris: thanks. can we capture owners + short ETAs here so ops can update the incident doc?

sre_miko: i'll own rollout hardening: implement an atomic prepare/commit for the rotator and add a route-convergence gate before commit. ETA: 9d. JIRA: NET-2481.

nate: i will add a short-term LB config change: cap retries to 2 and apply a 2x backoff multiplier during rotator windows under a feature-flag. PR by Mon. JIRA: NET-2482.

karen: i'll own post-deploy validation & CI gate: per-region SNI/cert-subject check + a 1m probe sweep; rollback on mismatch. ETA: 3d. JIRA: NET-2483.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: cert-rotator canary scheduled v6.0.3 -> v6.0.4 at 2025-11-09T03:00Z (dry-run 20m prior).

sre_miko: alert draft (PromQL):
```
(sum by(region)(rate(lb_retry_total[5m])) / sum by(region)(rate(lb_request_total[5m]))) > 0.04
```
-> page SRE if sustained 8m.

chris: i also saw BGP withdraws about 11s before the spike; nate please correlate with peering logs and open a follow-up if needed.

nate: opened NET-2484 to investigate BGP withdraw timing and flap dampening. preliminary ETA: 4d for mitigation plan.

vera: compact action table for incident doc (owner, jira, task, ETA):
- sre_miko, NET-2481, atomic prepare/commit rotator + route gate, 9d
- nate, NET-2482, LB retry-cap feature-flag, Mon EOD
- karen, NET-2483, post-deploy SNI probes + CI gate, 3d
- nate, NET-2484, BGP withdraw investigation, 4d

chris: i'll update the Confluence postmortem with this table and link to runbook snippet. please paste PR links here when ready.

sre_miko: scheduling 25m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to review acceptance criteria. invite sent.

vera: using this thread as canonical action tracker. ping here for timeline slips or blocked PRs. :white_check_mark:
